theme_and_archetype.rationale: For an Indian referral and e-commerce platform dealing with money (₹100 registration, payouts), we must project absolute trust, stability, and growth. Avoiding generic tech-bro neon or dark themes. We use a grounded, organic palette based on Deep Forest Green and warm Off-Whites to make the app feel established, premium, and safe.

rules: Headings MUST use the Outfit font with tight letter spacing.
Never use pure black; text is #1C2520.
Overlines for sections (like 'YOUR NETWORK') must be uppercase, tiny, and widely spaced.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Native mobile screens shouldn't feel cramped.

onboarding_hero.description: Illustration of wallet with money banknotes coins and bank card, arrows up. Use for onboarding or empty state of wallet.

avatars.description: Indian professional man in black shirt (User avatar 2)
Smiling Indian professional man in vest (User avatar 4)

products.description: White shopping bag with red sale tag and mini shopping cart (E-com product placeholder 1)
Shopping cart with cosmetics and white paper bag (E-com product placeholder 2)

authentication.layout: Clean white background. Large typography for 'Join the Network'.
authentication.features: Phone number/Email login, OTP verification. ₹100 Registration Fee payment modal using Razorpay/UPI intent styling.

user_dashboard.hero: Large numerical display of 'Total Earnings' (e.g., ₹12,450) using text-5xl Outfit, with a subtle 'Withdraw' text button.
user_dashboard.bento_stats: 2x2 flex grid mapping out 'Direct Referrals', 'Team Size', 'Pending Payout', 'Rank'. Flat white cards with #143D2E text.
user_dashboard.actions: Quick action row for 'Copy Invite Link' and 'Update UPI'.

referral_tree.layout: Vertical tiered list instead of a messy horizontal graph. Root node at top (current user). Vertical line drawn using a 2px View or SVG, connecting to 4 direct child cards.
referral_tree.cards: Each child card shows Avatar, Name, Join Date, and an 'Expand' chevron to see their downline. Use nested FlatLists or accordions.

wallet_and_payouts.layout: Split view: Top half shows Available Balance with Terracotta (#E57A44) CTA button 'Request Withdrawal'. Bottom half is a Transaction History list.
wallet_and_payouts.inputs: Bank/UPI update screen with clear, large text inputs, rounded-xl, subtle border.

ecommerce_shop.layout: 2-column Masonry or flat grid for product catalog. Large images (max height 200px), minimal text (Title, Price). Add to cart button is just a minimal '+' icon button.

admin_dashboard.layout: List-heavy view. Segments for 'Pending Payouts', 'User Management', 'Transactions'. Focus on bulk approval UI (Checkboxes + 'Approve Selected' sticky bottom button).

instructions_to_main_agent:
TECH STACK: Expo React Native. Use NativeWind for Tailwind styling. NEVER use web-only HTML/CSS like
or

.
ICONS: Use @expo/vector-icons (Feather or Ionicons) or lucide-react-native. DO NOT USE EMOJIS.
NAVIGATION: Use a floating Bottom Tab Navigation style. A floating pill anchored to the bottom (e.g., bottom-6, mx-6, rounded-full, blurred background if possible).
REFERRAL TREE: Do not try to find a 3rd party tree library. Build a custom vertical hierarchy using nested Views/Flatlists and vertical borders (border-l-2) to simulate branches.
IMAGES: ONLY use the provided URLs in the media section. Do NOT use placeholder domains (no via.placeholder.com).
COLORS: Stick to the Organic Earthy palette. No generic neon purple or blue gradients. Use #143D2E for Primary brand moments and #E57A44 for CTAs.
TESTING: Ensure interactive elements have standard React Native testID attributes (e.g., testID="login-submit-button").
